script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.
It reuses a line from the Prep cards word for word.

terra.problem: Holding fast is not first in Joshua’s list; it comes after walking in the LORD’s ways and keeping His commandments. The text also does not say the rest flows from love and holding fast.
The text calls the altar imposing but does not say it could be seen from far away.
The text does not say how fast the news traveled or that the altar’s location explains its speed.
The passage does not say whether anyone offered blessings at the gathering.
The text does not say that nobody passed anything out at the gathering.
Saying everyone had someone in the room adds a room to a meeting whose setting the text does not describe.
The chiefs are identified as family leaders, but the text does not say they were not soldiers.
Phinehas is identified as a priest, but the text does not say he was the only priest in the group.
The explanation attributes the delegation’s manner to fear. A reason for their behavior cannot be added even when framed as a guess.
The leaders forbid building another altar, not building anything of their own. The final sentence makes the prohibition broader than the text does.
Saying Joshua put a charge of desertion to rest implies that such a charge had been made. The passage does not say that.
The passage does not say the altar was made of stone.
The drawer joke has no setup explaining what copy would have saved Papa Dorin some explaining, so the comparison does not make sense.
The text does not say everybody came expecting a fight.
The text says the leaders were satisfied, but it does not say the meeting ended quietly.
